description: THE ANSWERS people gave a PostHog survey, with the QUESTION TEXT resolved beside each answer: who (distinct_id), when, country, device and the page they were on. The customers' own words: the best raw input for ad hooks, angles and objections. questionId narrows to one question; with scoreLte / scoreGte on a rating question it pulls e.g. NPS detractors (scoreLte 6) or promoters (scoreGte 9). since / until are ISO timestamps. One page (limit 1-500, default 100) and the next offset when there is more. NEEDS THE OPTIONAL survey:read SCOPE on the PostHog personal API key (plus query:read, which every connection already has); without it this tool names the box to tick in PostHog, never a reconnect. Read-only, 0 credits. Needs PostHog connected.

excludeArchived.description: true = leave out responses to archived questions

offset.description: skip this many responses; use the nextOffset from the previous reply

questionId.description: one question id from the survey (see list_posthog_surveys with surveyId)

scoreGte.description: needs questionId; e.g. 9 for NPS promoters

scoreLte.description: needs questionId; e.g. 6 for NPS detractors

name: posthog_survey_responses
title: PostHog survey responses
